text:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 97  
Reason for Mistake:  
The first clear mistake was when WebSurfer identified **Dastardly Mash** as the oldest flavor based only on its early dates and then the workflow anchored on that assumption. The real task was to determine the **headstone visible in the background of the photo of the oldest flavor’s headstone**, not simply the oldest-looking flavor in the list. This led the search down the wrong path. In addition, later evidence in the conversation showed the page had other candidates and the site/photo context was not properly established before concluding. The incorrect grounding here is what caused the final wrong answer.
